cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put this envelope inside the picnic hamper before Mum comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Unpack it as she asked. Keep the envelope in your pocket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take it home, then. I'll collect it once Mum stops asking; no need to open it.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs an envelope hidden from Mum; A3 preserves B unpacking duty while changing concealment; A5 accepts removal and offers collection without explaining purpose.

responseLogic.evidence: Inside the hamper in A1 makes B2 unpacking a direct exposure risk; A3 pocket naturally creates B4 taking it home.

relationship.evidence: B2 must do Mum task and B4 worries about becoming custodian beyond the picnic.

heightening.evidence: B4 unwanted custody becomes A5 a useful hiding route with an offered collection and no opening.

specificity.evidence: A1 envelope, hamper and Mum arrival establish the immediate task; later lines make concealment clear without revealing the secret contents.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 accepting home, collecting later and keeping it closed all act on B4 consequence; no abstract secrecy explanation.
